question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Radha and Sheela __have been knowing each other __since they were children.
solution:
```html
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the use of the incorrect verb form "**have been knowing**".
 
• The present perfect continuous tense is not typically used with stative verbs like "know".
 
• The correct phrase should be "**have known each other**," ensurin
